title: Free prose, no labels
text:
Following the fatigue cracks found at the weld, the mounting bracket BRK-100 on the pump assembly moves
from Rev B to Rev C under ECN-1001. The change is effective from week 6, and existing stock may be used up until
week 7 since the parts are fully interchangeable. R. Rao has approved this notice.
